definitions.short: Immanuel , a type name of Isaiah's son
definitions.full: H6005. Immanuel עִמָּנוּאֵל proper name, masculine Immanuel ( with us is God ); — ׳י Isa 7:14 van d. H. Baer; אֵל עִמָּנוּ Gi; — name of child, symbolizing presence of ׳י to deliver his people (on interpret. see Commentaries) — אֵל עִמָּנוּ 8:8 , 10 is declaration of trust and confidence, with us is God ! (compare Psa 46:8 ; Psalm 46:12); see עִם .
definitions.rootNote: from 5973 and with a pronominal suffix inserted; with us (is) God ;
